node.title: The LS6 determinant chart has canonical owners and exact fixed-owner packing
node.statement: For every distinct guarded split point in the LS6 determinant chart, G=gcd(D_0,H) is exactly gcd(D_0,D_H). Writing D_0=GA, D_H=GB, H=GK gives pairwise-coprime G,A,B, the normalized determinant K=AQ_H-BQ_0, and the exact primitive guard gcd(K,B)=gcd(G,Q_H)=1. At fixed owner degree g, candidate-only root sets have size j-g in the |C|-j points outside the base and pairwise intersection at most h-g, so their number is at most floor(binomial(|C|-j,h-g+1)/binomial(j-g,h-g+1)). For g=h-c and b<ell this is less than 3^(c+1) per owner. Aggregation over different owners remains open.
